content.hero.heroTitle: Find your own cloud in deep space
content.hero.heroSubtitle: A steady light in the dark. Real operations, complete credentials and independent architecture — reliability is the default from your first server.
content.why.whyText: The certainty the cloud should provide, delivered in one go.
content.why.feature1Text: Legally registered with real operations, verifiable from the very first conversation.
content.why.feature2Text: Filing and service licenses are in place; compliance is the baseline, not a bonus.
content.why.feature3Text: Self-built architecture and owned resources — scale up without gatekeepers, on your own roadmap.
content.stats.stat1Desc: Our own architecture keeps watch; downtime is not an option.
content.stats.stat2Desc: Whenever something comes up, you get an answer.
content.stats.stat3Desc: A registered business; every order is compliant and traceable.
content.cta.ctaTitle: Getting to the cloud should not be complicated
content.cta.ctaText: Pick a configuration, deploy, go live — a few steps is all it takes.
content.blog.firstCloud.title: Choosing your first cloud server
content.blog.firstCloud.excerpt: CPU, memory, bandwidth, routing… size it to your business and never pay for what you do not use.
content.blog.firstCloud.body: Sizing is the first step to the cloud. A small site or a dev/test box runs smoothly on 2 cores and 4 GB; as you grow, upgrade smoothly and settle monthly or yearly. Tell us what you need and we will help estimate usage, so you never pay for idle resources.
content.blog.nightSky.title: Stability is designed
content.blog.nightSky.excerpt: From architecture to operations, every step serves predictability.
content.blog.nightSky.body: Real operations, complete credentials and self-owned architecture — we have done all three since day one. Choosing us means choosing a cloud you can see, verify and rely on.
content.testimonials.1.quote: Credentials, pricing and response times all put us at ease. We rarely have to worry about running our business here.
content.testimonials.1.name: Li Qiang
content.testimonials.2.quote: From sizing to launch there was someone with us the whole way, faster than we expected.
content.testimonials.2.name: Zhou Min
content.testimonials.3.quote: Upgrade when I want, switch routes when I want — nothing feels locked in.
content.testimonials.3.name: Chen Hao
